sources.snippet: About the source model hotdogs/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated is a training-free abliterated build of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (a dense 27B native vision-language model with hybrid full-attention + linear-attention architecture). Refusal behaviour is removed by a single forward-only rank-1 weight edit that orthogonalizes the "refusal direction" out of the 131 residual-stream writers — no fine-tuning, no ...

sources.title: hotdogs/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated • hfviewer
sources.snippet: Where the model could be executed, the graph is trace-backed; otherwise it is derived from the reviewed configuration and source code. hotdogs/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated is an image-text-to-text model (qwen3_5_text architecture). It uses 64 transformer layers, a hidden size of 5,120, and 24 query heads with 4 key/value heads (grouped-query attention).
